title: 科技英语
description: 数字产品与科技阅读入门词汇，原创释义与例句。

words.example: The app uses an algorithm to sort the results.
words.translation: 这个应用使用算法对结果进行排序。

words.example: This application helps users track their daily habits.
words.translation: 这个应用帮助用户记录日常习惯。

words.example: Keep the device away from water while charging.
words.translation: 充电时请让设备远离水。

words.example: The library offers access to digital magazines.
words.translation: 图书馆提供数字杂志的阅读服务。

words.example: A useful feature lets you save words for later.
words.translation: 一个实用功能可以让你把单词保存起来以后复习。

words.example: The device connects to the network automatically.
words.translation: 这台设备会自动连接网络。

words.example: The service gives users control over their privacy.
words.translation: 这项服务让用户能够管理自己的隐私。

words.example: The computer can process large files quickly.
words.translation: 这台电脑可以快速处理大型文件。

words.example: Use a secure password for your account.
words.translation: 请为账户使用安全的密码。

words.example: Please update the app to get the latest features.
words.translation: 请更新应用以获取最新功能。

words.example: The design was tested with new users.
words.translation: 这项设计经过了新用户测试。
